options.html: Other than those given in options

questions.solution: In August 1920, the resolution to start Non-Cooperation movement was taken by Indian National Congress and the main objective was to gain Swaraj from the British government. In September, 1920, a special session of the Congress, presided by Lala Lajpat Rai was convened at Calcutta to approve the scheme. Later it was called off in 1922 because of a violent incident in Uttar Pradesh.

questions.question: JL Nehru called which among the following 'It was a new charter of slavery'?
questions.questionHtml: JL Nehru called which among the following 'It was a new charter of slavery'?
questions.solution: Government of India was passed in 1935 and it meant for creation of the federal structure for our country. It introduced provincial autonomy, abolished diarchy in provinces and also made ministers responsible to the legislative and the federation at the centre. However, JL Nehru opined that 'It was a new charter of slavery'.
